Candy Corn Cookie (Korean: 캔디콘맛 쿠키, kaendikon-mat kuki) is an Epic Cookie released alongside her Pet, Crackle Corn, in the first half of the Our Special Pie Party! update, as part of Cookie Run: OvenBreak's eighth anniversary celebrations.

Story

"Beep beep! That's not right! Let's make this pumpkin moon party perfect!" she exclaims, her tiny hands scattering candies with joyful abandon. Perched atop her head is an oversized candy corn, meticulously crafted in just the right late autumn hues. It's hard to believe, but this little Cookie's been head over heels for pumpkin moon parties since before she could even tell a pumpkin from a ghost!

Is it her uncanny resemblance to a pointy traffic cone that makes her such a stickler for rules? Whatever the reason, this party planner takes her role very seriously. Watch her adorably stomp her feet when things don't meet her exacting standards! With boundless energy, she scurries through the village, whistle at the ready. No imperfection in the garden pumpkin decorations or ghost figurines escapes her keen eye.

As dusk falls and houses begin to twinkle with warm lights, Candy Corn Cookie's excitement reaches a fever pitch. Door to door she goes, eagerly knocking and shaking her pumpkin basket with glee. Worried she might play a trick if you don't offer a treat? Fear not! There're a plenty of candies to share!

Affection Jelly

Isn't every day a party if you smile as brightly as the full moon?

Skill

Candy Corn Cookie's Skill
Scatters Candy Corn Jellies from the pumpkin basket after collecting a certain number of Jellies. Every fourth activation, Candy Corn Firecrackers fly and explode. Level Up for more points for Candy Corn Jellies.

Changelog

  • Voyage to the World of Dreams! - October 27, 2025
    • Obtained a Costume,  Star Voyage Guide.
    • Obtained a Combi Bonus with Gigawatt Cube.
    • Increased points for Candy Corn Jellies.
    • The Forbidden Manuscript Treasure no longer affects Candy Corn Jellies.
    • Removed Combi Bonus with Jolly Jack O'Lantern.
  • Mystery on the SS Cargot - September 25, 2025
    • Changed so the Jellies created during the Cookies' skills move at the same speed/angles every run.
  • Our Special Pie Party! - October 25, 2024
    • Added to the game alongside a Costume,  Pie Delivery Scout.

Trivia

  • Candy Corn Cookie's various skills behaves similarly to that of Lollipop Cookie's, though instead of requiring the collection of only Bear Jellies, Candy Corn Cookie requires the collection of any Jellies to activate her skills.
  • While Cookie Run: OvenBreak went into maintenance to add Candy Corn Cookie, every other game connected to Devplay crashed. While unknown if it was connected to the crash, once the Our Special Pie Party! update was live, Android users were not able to update the game as Google Play did not allow it. This caused Candy Corn Cookie to be released at two separate times for iOS and Android users.
    • A similar situation happened with the release of Mala Sauce Cookie five years earlier.
  • The player can unlock Walnut Cookie on Candy Corn Cookie's relationship chart by putting Candy Corn Cookie in the Pumpkin Moon Pie Party Lobby.
